comment: The Algorithm Select jack scales its voltage by SORTER_ARRAY_EVENTS_COUNT, which is 8, rather than by the number of algorithms, which is 27 (SortStep.cpp:468 against SorterAlgorithm.hpp:20 and 32-60). 10V therefore lands on the ninth algorithm and the clamp to 26 is never reached, so the jack cannot select the other eighteen; the on-screen menu can. The scale mapping on the key output can also carry the outputs above the Scale knob's setting, up to the ±10V clamp at SortStep.cpp:97.
